A tool-enabled model can propose a structured tool call. The application validates arguments,
authorizes execution, runs the tool and returns results. Agents may repeat this cycle within limits.
AI agent එක tool call එකකේ Jයහෝජනා කළතේ සුබෑ action එක execute කරන්Jන් app එකයි.

Real-world example
A support agent reads order status but needs approval to change an order.
